message.content:
**Answer:**  
As of the latest available data (up to 2024‑09), the highest‑grossing movie worldwide is **“Avatar” (2009)**, which has earned roughly **$2.92 billion USD** across global box office receipts.  

> *Key points*  
> • “Avatar,” directed by James Cameron and released in December 2009, held the record for many years.  
> • In 2019, “Avengers: Endgame” briefly overtook it, but subsequent re‑releases of “Avatar” pushed its total back above the threshold.  
> • If you adjust for inflation or consider domestic-only grosses, the rankings shift (e.g., “Gone with the Wind” tops the inflation‑adjusted list).  

Feel free to ask if you'd like more details—such as how the numbers were calculated, other films close behind, or historical changes over time!
